stats.notes: CDS C1 fall 2024 first-year class: 40,021 applied, 35,337 admitted (88%), 5,087 enrolled (full-time plus part-time). Oregon left the C1 residency breakdown (in-state, out-of-state, international) blank, so international applicants and admits are null; CDS H6 lists 40 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates with institutional aid. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. SAT/ACT figures cover the 8% (SAT, 412 students) and 5% (ACT, 272 students) of enrollees who submitted scores; Oregon is test-optional. The C7 factor check boxes could not be read reliably, so factors are omitted. The CDS cost table is labelled 2024-25 and was not used; costs come from the financial aid office.
